test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
What would be the symbol on the opposite side of '≤' if the given sheet is folded to form a cube?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13a5e9b02abd451b288ac1577de6e6280f1cb88f39ed6638adab0a314e44d226.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa7398f7a4b9899f1b7b4a9a7e38ee0f4eb45f8867297e8460f408dd5ba6fd18.png] 

⇒ As the alternate positions become opposite to each other, the remaining two faces become opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

* → ≠

≤ → ÷

+ → ≥

Therefore, '÷' is the opposite of '≤'.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
